Fresh sashami
Oct 2026 • Family
We were so happy to enjoy raw shrimp and cuttlefish sashimi—both can be hard to find even in Korea! We’ve been traveling around Nha Trang for over ten days and have had plenty of delicious meals, but this place really stands out for its freshness. The cuttlefish sashimi was especially impressive: it was carefully scored with fine cuts, making it wonderfully tender and easy to eat. Highly recommended!
